age.evidence: Blood from adult donors was obtained after written informed consent with approval from the Ethics Committee of Boston Children's Hospital; Boston, MA (protocol number X07–05-0223).

Cord blood samples were collected and de-identified with approval from the Ethics Committee of The Brigham & Women's Hospital, Boston, MA (protocol number 2000-P-000117) and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center Boston, MA (protocol number 2011P-000118).

cell_type.evidence: Monocytes were isolated from mononuclear cell fractions by positive selection with magnetic microbeads according to the manufacturer's instructions (Miltenyi Biotec; Auburn, CA) using CD14 as a pan-marker for monocytes.
